ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a macro-ratio of approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels to 40% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and leading edges are dominated by contiguous low-intensity black pixels. High-intensity white pixels form dense, streaked, and mottled patterns concentrated on the posterior sections of both lobes, extending to the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations extracted along the entire posterior boundary, with vertical pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels, creating a jagged profile isolated from the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curvature along the trailing margins, tapering into acute, upward-pointing distal vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large, dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast, raised pixel groupings localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the mid-left lobe, cutting diagonally through the high-intensity white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations at the distal tips; multiple parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular focal spot located within the white pigmented region of the mid-left lobe.
